description: This file defines the DeviceHandler class which provides methods to gather and serialize various device status info, permissions, and health data on Android devices. It includes methods for retrieving battery status, storage info, network connectivity, device specifications, and permissions.

classes.name: DeviceHandler
classes.description: Main class for handling device status, info, permissions, and health data retrieval and serialization.

classes.name: BatterySnapshot
classes.description: Data class representing a snapshot of device battery status.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus
methods.description: Returns a serialized JSON string with current device status such as battery, thermal, storage, and network info.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo
methods.description: Returns a serialized JSON string with device identifying information and system properties.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions
methods.description: Returns a serialized JSON string with current permissions status for various device features.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth
methods.description: Returns a serialized JSON string with device health metrics including memory, battery, power modes, and system info.

methods.name: statusPayloadJson
methods.description: Constructs JSON payload with battery, thermal, storage, and network status.

methods.name: infoPayloadJson
methods.description: Constructs JSON payload with device model, system version, app version, and locale info.

methods.name: permissionsPayloadJson
methods.description: Constructs JSON payload with permissions status for camera, microphone, location, SMS, notifications, photos, contacts, calendar, call log, and motion sensors.

methods.name: healthPayloadJson
methods.description: Constructs JSON payload with memory, battery, power modes, and system security patch info.

methods.name: readBatterySnapshot
methods.description: Reads current battery status and levels, returning a BatterySnapshot object.

methods.name: batteryLevelFraction
methods.description: Calculates battery level as a fraction from BatteryManager intent.

methods.name: mapBatteryState
methods.description: Maps battery status integer to a descriptive string.

methods.name: mapChargingType
methods.description: Maps charging plugged type to a descriptive string.

methods.name: mapThermalState
methods.description: Maps thermal status from PowerManager to descriptive string.

methods.name: mapNetworkStatus
methods.description: Maps NetworkCapabilities to a network status string.

methods.name: permissionStateJson
methods.description: Helper to create JSON object for permission state with status and promptability.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has a specific permission granted.

methods.name: mapMemoryPressure
methods.description: Determines memory pressure level based on total and available RAM, and low memory flag.

methods.name: networkInterfacesJson
methods.description: Builds JSON array listing active network interfaces based on NetworkCapabilities.
